name: Jezero Crater region (Mars 2020 landing-site CTX products)

crs.name: Equirectangular, Mars 2000 sphere (R = 3396190 m)
crs.note: East-west ground scale is exact only at 18.4663 N; at the north/south edges of the area it is off by about +/-0.5 %.

elevation.unit: metres (not stated in the GeoTIFF metadata; consistent with Jezero Crater's known relief)
elevation.datum: Not stated in file metadata (Mars 2000 sphere / MOLA-referenced DEM)

texture.note: Source CTX orthoimage is panchromatic (grayscale); no natural colour is contained in the data.

sources.credit: USGS Astrogeology / NASA Mars 2020 terrain data, CTX DEM, 20 m/px
USGS Astrogeology / NASA Mars 2020 terrain data, CTX orthomosaic, 5 m/px

transformations: Cropped DEM and orthomosaic to their common ground extent (snapped to the DEM pixel grid).
DEM block-averaged 2x2 (NaN-aware mean) from 20.0 m to 40.0 m cells; no smoothing or filtering beyond that.
0 NoData cells filled by inverse-distance interpolation for rendering only; mask in nodata.bin.
Orthomosaic area-averaged (rasterio Resampling.average) from ~5 m to 21.69 m/px; pixel values not otherwise altered.
No reprojection: both inputs already share the same equirectangular CRS (standard parallel 18.4663), so geometry and texture align by coordinates.

unused.reason: See docs/DATASETS.md - different CRS/standard parallel and unresolved vertical (~13 m) and possible horizontal offset against the CTX DEM; kept separate.
